utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. If you can bring a few basic tools and help sort the donations, that would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll bring a few basic tools and help sort the donations.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but we should pin down the timing and drop-off details first so nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, can you confirm what time works and where we should drop things off?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can do early afternoon, around 2 o’clock, and we should drop everything at the community center side entrance.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I haven’t checked the details yet, but I can take a look if you want.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Noah — that’d be a big help. I keep meaning to check it, but my brain’s been a bit all over the place.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: No problem — I’ll check the details and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can pass the word along about the repair drive. I’ll remind folks and keep the plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I appreciate you spreading the word and keeping it moving. Let me know if you need anything from me while you’re out.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll let you know if I need anything, and I’ll keep reminding folks about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Gus, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries, Dane — it’s going well so far. I’ve got a few tools ready if you need anything.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — that’s great. I can help out wherever you need me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help with the repair drive. If we keep it simple, I can bring a few tools and be there first thing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s perfect, Eli — thank you! I’ll let the others know you’re in and bring the tools you mentioned.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good — first thing works for me. I’ll bring the tools and keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely, Mina — I’m still on for it. Just tell me what time you want to meet.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — how about 3 PM at my place?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help get the repair drive going—want me to help spread the word or make a quick list of what’s needed?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: A quick list would help most—let’s note what’s needed and where to drop it off.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll make a simple list of needed items and a drop-off spot, then we can share it around. If you want, I can also add a contact for questions.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Mara — we still need a few volunteers to sort supplies and a couple people to do quick follow-ups with the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can take either one — just point me to the supplies or the follow-ups, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what we’ve got for the repair drive and note what still needs to be picked up.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: That’d be great, thanks — just let me know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll do that and send you a quick list of anything still missing. We should be in good shape once I check the supplies.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is coming together nicely—people have been dropping off tools and donations all morning. If you need anything fixed, now’s a good time to mention it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. I’ve got a wobbly chair I could bring by if there’s room.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Absolutely, bring it by — I’m sure they’ll find a spot for it. The more little fixes we catch now, the better!

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I say anything—what part of the repair drive do you need me to check?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Could you please confirm the drop-off time and which items are still needed? I want to make sure I share the right details.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I can check that for you—what time is the drop-off, and which items are still needed?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I’m in, but keep it quick—what do you need from me for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just a quick hand loading and dropping off supplies—nothing fancy. If you can swing by the lot this afternoon, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can swing by this afternoon. Just point me to the lot and I’ll help load up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to help out at the repair drive, and I’ll mention it to the others too.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s wonderful, Vik — thank you for spreading the word. I’m sure the repair drive will be stronger with everyone pitching in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — I’ll keep mentioning the repair drive to everyone I talk to.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I might’ve missed the latest update, but I’m glad it’s happening.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, it’s still going ahead. Thank you for being willing to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Of course — just point me to what still needs doing, and I’ll pitch in where I can.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I’m happy to help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Rey — we could use a ladder, a drill, and a few screwdrivers for the repair drive. I’ll swing by and coordinate what’s still needed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sounds good, Gus. I can check whether I have any of those and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — I’m getting the repair drive organized, and I’d love your help making sure we cover the neighbors who need it most. What should we prioritize first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’d start with the neighbors who have urgent repairs or safety issues, then anyone who depends on the equipment to get by day to day.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That makes sense — I’ll put urgent safety repairs first, then the folks who rely on their equipment every day. If you think of anyone specific, send them my way and I’ll add them to the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d want to know the time, what we’re bringing, and where everything should go first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — it’s this Saturday at 10, we’re bringing gloves, tape, and any spare tools, and we’ll sort everything by the curb near the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds doable, but I’d still like to know who’s coordinating the drop-off so I don’t put things in the wrong spot.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is definitely still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m not sure yet — let me check the details before I say for certain.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, please confirm and let me know once you’ve checked.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll help make a clear plan for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m late, but I can help with that — maybe we should list the biggest repairs first and see what materials we need.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good—let’s start with the biggest repairs and make a clean list of materials right after.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s getting organized—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t seen the full list yet, but I can check what’s still needed and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’d appreciate that. I’m still mostly going off bits and pieces, so any update would help.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m happy to help, I just need a quick reminder of what still needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — we still need a few hands for sorting donations, checking tools, and helping with simple repairs. If you’re free, I can put you on one of those.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I can do sorting donations — that sounds easiest for me. Just point me where to start and I’ll jump in.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive. What timing are you thinking about?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye. Late afternoon on weekdays would work best for me, after school lets out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works for me too — late afternoon on weekdays should be easiest to coordinate around school pickup. I’ll keep that window in mind for the repair drive.
